limitations: No validated S. mansoni blacklist is frozen; no blacklist filtering is applied.
PRJNA219440 and PRJNA384372 are alignment-only because public matched controls are absent.
The current HelixForge ChIP API applies one peak_type per run, so mixed-mark studies are split into narrow and broad invocations.
The pipeline performs raw FastQC but no native ChIP trimming in v1.1.0.
